name: TOMC Memory
name_zh: TOMC Memory · 省 token 小猫
description: Prepare compact task context and carry project notes across agents, with an optional desktop cat to show your savings.
description_zh: 让猫猫帮你省 token：本地整理任务上下文，保存项目要求和待办，换 Code Agent、换电脑也能接着干。可选桌面小猫展示节省统计和任务笔记。
description_en: Prepare compact task context and carry project notes across agents, with an optional desktop cat to show your savings.
examples_zh: 用 TOMC 保存我提供的项目要求和待办，笔记命名为发布计划。
从 TOMC 的发布计划笔记中找回未完成事项，接着列出下一步。
把我提供的长会议记录整理成适合写行动清单的紧凑上下文。
examples_en: Save the project requirements and unfinished work I provided in a TOMC notebook named release-plan.
Recall unfinished work from the release-plan notebook and outline the next steps.
Prepare compact context from the meeting notes I provided for writing an action checklist.
